# The public surface of crates/iyakki-core-api, one item per line (docs/development/CORE-COMPATIBILITY-DESIGN.md section 8).
# Written by crates/iyakki-core-api/tests/core_surface.rs; do not edit by hand. A new item is appended by running the test with
# IYAKKI_CORE_SURFACE_WRITE=1. An item that disappears or changes shape becomes a `removed<TAB>item<TAB>note` line, which needs
# IYAKKI_CORE_SURFACE_NOTE="why, and which version or alias covers it". Gate: ./run.sh compat-check.
